name: ims.context-rag
description: IMS context retrieval tools for unified project context (code, docs, long-term memories)

tools.name: context_search
tools.description: Search across project context (code, docs, IMS memories) and return ranked snippets.

query.description: Natural language query describing what context is needed.

sources.description: Optional list of source types to search, e.g. ['code','docs','memories']. Defaults to all when omitted.
